description: Cherat Packaging Limited manufactures paper sacks, polypropylene bags and flexible packaging for the food, beverage, pharmaceutical, home and personal-care, cement, sugar and chemical sectors, and is one of the largest suppliers of polypropylene bags to Pakistan's cement industry. Incorporated in 1989, it runs Polypropylene, SOS/carrier bag and Flexible Packaging divisions — flexible packaging began in 2018 with rotogravure and flexographic printing and extrusion — from a factory at Gadoon Amazai, Swabi.
headOffice: Modern Motors House, Beaumont Road, Karachi 75530, Pakistan
